adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which requires the user to be both a team admin and a team owner. The variable name and typical permission model imply it should allow either role (OR). As written, a team admin who is not an owner will fail the permission check and be denied (`FORBIDDEN`), causing incorrect behavior.
